rules.sentence: Without prompt diagnosis and treatment, renal failure may follow rapidly.

Rapid-onset dyspnea and anemia, with or without hemoptysis and bilateral patchy infiltrates (seen on chest x-ray) may be due to alveolar hemorrhage, a medical emergency that requires immediate treatment.
